channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Congo Ebola death toll exceeds 2,000 in fastest-spreading outbreak on record
item.description: At least 2,000 people have died among confirmed cases in Congo's Ebola outbreak, which is the fastest-spreading on record, according to the latest figures.

item.title: Trump asserts U.S. control over Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing standoff
item.description: The standoff between the two nations intensifies as President Trump echoes Iran's compensation demand and asserts U.S. control over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Russia using North Korean missiles in Ukraine
item.description: Russia and North Korea have been cooperating in the offensive against Ukraine since 2024.

item.title: Trump demands Iran pay compensation following new conditions for reopening strait
item.description: President Trump indicated he would increase economic pressure on Iran as the standoff continued and Tehran set new terms for reopening the strait.
